show.description: After a messy divorce from politician Prince Randeep Mehra, elegant and sharp-witted Lady Diana reinvents herself not as a victim, but as a bold force navigating power, politics, and passion. From scandalous headlines to a secret second life, Diana sets out to reclaim her identity, challenge old norms, and prove that her story didn’t end with marriage it only began. Watch Now!
